watch.summary: The streamer screams in intense excitement as pro Valorant player Cryo clutches a round to win the match.

beats.what: Streamer watches Cryo navigate a crucial overtime round in Valorant.
Cryo flashes and gets a kill, prompting an excited 'Oh' from the streamer.
Cryo secures the final kill and round win, causing the streamer to scream 'Let's go!'.
Streamer jumps around and yells in celebration along with the broadcast footage.

watch.author: pro_player_in_footage
watch.why: This clip is focused on esports excitement and hype rather than comedic humor. The entertainment value comes from the high-energy celebration of an impressive match win.
